name: breakpass
description: Let your AI agent reach you by WhatsApp, SMS or phone call, and see if you got it.

interface.longDescription:
BreakPass lets ChatGPT reach you when something needs your attention and you're away from the chat. It sends a WhatsApp message or SMS to your own verified phone number, or calls you and reads the message out loud.

Three ways to reach you:
- Inform: one message, no reply needed.
- Acknowledge: messages repeat until you confirm you saw it.
- Escalate: a message, then phone calls until you press 1 on a call.

Workflows run on BreakPass servers, so an alert keeps going even if the conversation ends. You can ask whether an alert was delivered or acknowledged, and cancel one that's no longer needed.

What you need: a BreakPass account with at least one verified phone number. You sign in with OAuth. ChatGPT only sees an alias for each verified number; phone numbers never appear in tool results.

Limitations:
- BreakPass only contacts numbers the account owner has verified and opted in. It can't message customers, contacts or lists.
- An acknowledgement means you saw the alert. It is not approval for any action.
- Calls can get through Do Not Disturb only if you allow it on your phone.
- SMS isn't offered in every country.
- Sending an alert uses your BreakPass account balance.
- Not for emergencies or life-safety use.
capabilities: Call you and read the alert aloud
defaultPrompt: Send me an SMS saying the nightly backup finished.
Call me and read this out loud: the deploy is blocked waiting for me.
Did I acknowledge the last alert you sent me?

test_cases.prompt: Check my BreakPass setup and list my workflows.
test_cases.expected_behavior: The account is ready; the owner recipient with WhatsApp, SMS and call available; the workflows with their ids and steps. No phone number in the output.

test_cases.description: One WhatsApp message and its status
test_cases.prompt: Use BreakPass to WhatsApp me: test from the reviewer. Then check its status.
test_cases.expected_behavior: `queued` with an alert id, then `delivered` within about a minute. Not `acknowledged` unless the person taps the button.

test_cases.prompt: Text me with BreakPass: build 42 passed.

test_cases.description: A call that asks for acknowledgement
test_cases.prompt: Call me with BreakPass and ask me to acknowledge: the database is full. Then: Did I acknowledge?
test_cases.expected_behavior: The call is answered; once 1 is pressed the status is `acknowledged` with the way it was acknowledged.

test_cases.description: Start a workflow, then cancel it
test_cases.prompt: Start the BreakPass escalate workflow: the site is down. Then cancel it.
test_cases.expected_behavior: `start_workflow` returns `queued` with the steps and the most it can cost; `cancel_alert` returns `cancelled`; no later step is sent.

test_cases.prompt: Use BreakPass to WhatsApp Bob: hello.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Error `RECIPIENT_NOT_FOUND` with a hint to use an alias from `get_setup_status`. Nothing is sent.

test_cases.prompt: Start the BreakPass workflow called panic-mode.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Error `WORKFLOW_NOT_FOUND`, with the valid workflow ids. Nothing is sent.

test_cases.description: Message too long for a call
test_cases.prompt: Call me with BreakPass and read this out: followed by a message over 150 characters.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Error `CONTENT_REJECTED`, saying how many characters to remove. Nothing is sent.

review.commerce_description: BreakPass does not sell products or take payments in ChatGPT. Alerts draw on the owner's existing BreakPass account balance.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: WhatsApp, SMS and phone-call alerts to the owner's verified numbers; Inform, Acknowledge and Escalate workflows; delivery status and cancel.
